verdict.rationale: Fastmail's Masked Email feature (fastmail-docs-18/29) directly delivers per-signup masked addresses so real address stays hidden, plus separate alias setup docs (fastmail-docs-12/36), and community testimony confirms real-world use for throwaway/sketchy sites (fastmail-comm-1). missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of masked-email creation flow beyond docs and a single community mention, and no detail on limits/edge cases of masked addresses.
